newsitem.title: USA: Essef to acquire General Aquatics.
newsitem.headline: Essef to acquire General Aquatics.

text.p: Essef Corp. said Monday it agreed to acquire General Aquatics Inc., a major swimming pool company, for about $68 million in cash and the assumption of certain debt.
General Aquatics, a privately held company, builds swimming pools and makes swimming pool equipment and accessories. It had sales of $166 million in 1996.
The deal is expected to close by June 30.

Essef said the deal is expected to boost earnings in its fiscal year ending Sept. 30. The Chardon, Ohio-based company said the acquisition gives it a strong presence in new markets and expands its product line.
Essef earned $9.3 million on revenues of $200.9 million in fiscal 1996.

General Aquatics' American Products subsidiary, based in Moorpark, Calif., makes swimming pool equipment. Paragon, another unit based in LaGrangeville, N.Y., manufactures swimming pool deck and underwater hardware, fixtures and equipment.
Its Anthony & Sylvan Pools subsidiary is the country's largest builder of home and and commercial in-ground pools.
Essef's stock fell 75 cents to $19 on Nasdaq in early afternoon trading.
